entries.description: REST API for the Bizzabo Event Experience OS. Programmatic access to events, registrations, contacts, orders, agenda/sessions, speakers, partners, and webhooks. OAuth 2.0 client-credentials auth.
representativeQueries: pull registration and attendee data from an event management platform
list the sessions and speakers for a conference via API
create or update event registrations programmatically
sync event contacts and orders into my CRM
subscribe to webhooks for new event registrations

entries.description: Read-only MCP server over Bizzabo's published marketing content — blog posts, Event Experience Podcast episodes, customer case studies, guides, reports and product comparisons. Returns clean markdown with citable URLs. No credentials required.
representativeQueries: find Bizzabo customer case studies in healthcare
show how a company ran a large conference on Bizzabo
get event marketing blog posts and planning guides
list Event Experience Podcast episodes about attendee engagement
compare Bizzabo to other event management platforms
